parts.text: I am a dispatcher, and my company's policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us, though I do want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts. Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, and inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. My notes do not state whether I mean reachable along open corridors, within range, and fit for the job, nor do they state what I do if a drone is not at the start site.
